theme_and_archetype.description: Sovereign AI Command Deck. A high-contrast, technical, non-SaaS HUD layout. Avoids modern AI app cliches (no purple/teal gradients). Uses deep black, stark monochrome structural lines, and singular sharp neon accents to establish an authoritative, advanced feel like a military or aerospace terminal.

headings.description: Used for major numeric readouts, section headers, and HUD data points.

body.description: Used for terminal output, AI responses, logs, and UI labels.

rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans-serif.
Labels must be uppercase with wide tracking.
Data values and metrics should be large, tight, and high-contrast.
No gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors with texture.
Accent colors must be used sparingly—only for active statuses, neural core highlights, and critical alerts.
Text over images or complex backgrounds must have a subtle text-shadow or a dark scrim behind it.

layout_and_spacing.container: h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4 p-4 bg-[#050505]

zones.left_console: w-full md:w-1/4 h-full flex flex-col gap-4. Houses the AI Chat, Conversation Memory Log, and terminal inputs.
zones.center_core: w-full md:w-2/4 h-full relative border border-white/10 flex flex-col. Houses the 3D Neural Network, floating HUD metrics.
zones.right_telemetry: w-full md:w-1/4 h-full flex flex-col gap-4. Houses the Map Preview, Device Permissions toggle list, and Network Status.
zones.bottom_command_bar: Absolute or flex-docked to the bottom. Contains the master voice input toggle, connection status, and audio visualizer.

surfaces_and_effects.panels: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-none or max rounded-sm.
surfaces_and_effects.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]. Used for floating command palettes or modal overlays.
retro_futurism: Use subtle CSS repeating-linear-gradient overlays for scanlines on camera or map feeds.
Add a subtle `drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(204,255,0,0.5)]` to active primary text or borders.
Incorporate 'corner cuts' (clip-path) on high-level HUD components if possible, otherwise stick to sharp 1px borders.

interactions_and_motion.loading: Use blocky, terminal-style ASCII loaders or fast-blinking cursors.
interactions_and_motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up and slide-in for list items (Memory log, permissions).

components_strategy.structure: Raw HTML + Tailwind. Avoid standard Shadcn 'Cards'—build custom panel divs with sharp borders.
components_strategy.interactive: Heavily customized Shadcn inputs, toggles (for permissions), and scroll areas. Strip default styling and apply the square/sharp retro-futuristic look.
components_strategy.charts_and_data: For audio visualizer, use simple animated div bars or an SVG. For the neural network, use React Force Graph 3D or D3.js. For maps, use Leaflet with a dark map tile provider (CartoDB Dark Matter).

radar_bg.description: Deep space radar texture, dark mode map background. Use as a fallback background for map panels or overlay textures.

neural_core_bg.description: Futuristic neural network core texture. Use as the background for the Center Core 3D view, or as the fallback if 3D fails to load.

abstract_network.description: Blue background with lines and dots. Can be used for holographic HUD overlays with mix-blend-screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Ensure Chakra Petch and JetBrains Mono are imported from Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
ICONS: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react for sharp, technical icons.
APP LAYOUT: Set body to full height (`h-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#050505] text-white`). Divide into 3 vertical columns on desktop (Left 25%, Center 50%, Right 25%).
LEFT PANEL (Console): Build a chat interface that looks like a command-line terminal. Include an 'Offline/Online' status indicator at the top. Memory logs should feel like system readouts.

CENTER PANEL (Neural Viz): This is the focal point. Use `react-force-graph-3d` or `react-three-fiber` to render a spinning, glowing node graph. Overlay HUD elements (like system integrity metrics) using position absolute.

RIGHT PANEL (Telemetry): Implement a mini-map using Leaflet (react-leaflet) with dark tiles. Below it, create a Device Permissions toggler (Camera, Mic, GPS, Bluetooth) with custom sharp switches. Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements.
BOTTOM BAR: A fixed HUD strip at the bottom containing voice input controls, a fake audio waveform visualizer, and master AI status.

AESTHETICS: Avoid rounded corners (use rounded-none). Use 1px borders with `border-white/10`. Use `#CCFF00` strictly for active toggles, primary buttons, or the glowing neural nodes. Do not use gradients.
Use 'mix-blend-screen' or 'mix-blend-plus-lighter' for layered holographic effects over images.
